rationale: Both types pass validate_evaluators structurally (no required companion fields) but require pipeline infrastructure (a maintained open-question-count history file; an actual Harbor benchmark scorer) that a generically-sketched state never produces, so widening to all 12 members of NON_LLM_EVALUATOR_TYPES would offer two types that are structurally valid but functionally broken if selected.
rule: Curated exclusion set — exclude open_question_stall and harbor_scorer from the generated evaluator vocabulary
alternatives_rejected: Accept the widening (generate all 12 members of NON_LLM_EVALUATOR_TYPES) — simpler generator body but reintroduces the two infra-dependent types as a functional landmine.
